title: Juniper Earthbake
description: An earthy, crisp, hangover-cure Indian dish featuring juniper berries, baked and plant-based-friendly.

ingredients.name: 2 cups buckwheat groats
ingredients.notes: Soaked in water for at least 4 hours

ingredients.name: 2 tbsp ground flaxseed
ingredients.notes: Mixed with 6 tbsp water to make flaxseed meal

ingredients.name: 2 tbsp grated fresh jaggery or maple syrup
1/4 tsp saffron threads, soaked in 1 tbsp warm milk to dissolve

instructions: In a large bowl, mix soaked buckwheat groats with flaxseed meal and all other ingredients except the milk-soaked saffron.
Mix well until smooth. Let it sit for at least an hour or up to overnight to allow flavors to meld together.
Add 1 tbsp of the lemon juice while mixing the mixture in a bowl, then add milk-soaked saffron and remaining lemon juice.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a baking dish with oil or cooking spray.
Pour the mixed batter into the prepared baking dish. Bake for 45-60 minutes or until golden brown and crispy on top.
Remove from heat, let it cool slightly before serving.
